name: National Atomic Company Kazatomprom JSC
content: National Atomic Company Kazatomprom JSC is the world's largest producer of natural uranium, accounting for approximately 20% of global primary uranium production. As the national operator of the Republic of Kazakhstan for the import and export of uranium, rare metals, and nuclear fuel for nuclear power plants, the company operates through its subsidiaries, affiliates, and joint ventures. Kazatomprom utilizes low-cost in-situ recovery (ISR) mining technology across all its mining operations, maintaining a leading position in the nuclear fuel cycle and contributing significantly to the global transition toward clean energy.

tabs.label: Management
tabs.content:
Officers

Meirzhan Yussupov(Date: 2023 October)

Chief Executive Officer

Meirzhan Yussupov has served as the CEO of Kazatomprom since October 2023. Previously, he held the position of Chairman of the Management Board of Kazakh Invest and served as Vice Minister of National Economy of the Republic of Kazakhstan. He has extensive experience in corporate finance and treasury, having previously worked at Kazatomprom as CFO.

Sultan Temirbayev(Date: 2023 August)

Chief Financial Officer

Sultan Temirbayev is the Chief Financial Officer. He joined Kazatomprom from Samruk-Kazyna, where he held various senior positions in the asset management and privatization departments. He has a strong background in investment banking and financial analysis.

Kuanysh Omarbekov(Date: 2023 June)

Chief Operating Officer

Kuanysh Omarbekov serves as the Chief Operating Officer. He has over 15 years of experience in the uranium mining industry, having held various management positions within Kazatomprom's subsidiaries, including Director of the Mining Department.

Dastan Kosherbayev(Date: 2023 June)

Chief Strategy and Development Officer

Dastan Kosherbayev is the Chief Strategy and Development Officer. He is responsible for strategic planning, M&A, and international projects. He previously worked in the corporate finance department of Samruk-Kazyna.

Directors

Arman Arshambayev(Date: 2023 November)

Chairman of the Board

Arman Arshambayev is the Chairman of the Board of Directors. He represents the interests of the majority shareholder, Samruk-Kazyna. He has significant experience in the public sector and corporate governance in Kazakhstan.

Neil Longwill(Date: 2018 October)

Independent Non-Executive Director

Neil Longwill is an Independent Non-Executive Director. He has over 30 years of experience in the international oil and gas industry, including senior roles at BP. He brings expertise in operations, safety, and project management.

Russell Banham(Date: 2018 October)

Independent Non-Executive Director

Russell Banham is an Independent Non-Executive Director. He is a former Deloitte partner with extensive experience in auditing and advisory services for large international mining and energy companies.

Keat Siang Wei(Date: 2023 May)

Independent Non-Executive Director

Keat Siang Wei is an Independent Non-Executive Director. He has a background in investment banking and corporate finance, with a focus on the natural resources sector in emerging markets.
